newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Jan department store sales rise on month.
newsitem.headline: Canada Jan department store sales rise on month.

text.p: Canadian department stores sales rose a seasonally adjusted 0.5 percent in January from December to C$1.25 billion, Statistics Canada said on Thursday.
In unadjusted data, year-over-year sales in January rose 7.9 percent to C$822.8 million.
The agency said that it would no longer provide sales figures broken down into major and discount department stores.
(For more information from Statistics Canada, contact Louise Genereux, Retail Trade Section, Industry Division, 613-951-3549.)
